title: AMPainterV2 designs membrane-lytic antimicrobial peptides by imitation learning
summary: AMPainterV2 uses generative adversarial imitation learning with a Mixture-of-Experts policy supporting insertion, deletion and mutation. In vitro, all ten top-ranked peptides evolved from random sequences were active membrane-lytic AMPs, the best with a mean MIC of 1.5 uM and membrane-lytic activity superior to polymyxin B. A deletion-only version yielded six miniaturized peptides with comparable or improved activity and an average 36% length reduction. Preprint; in vitro data only.
ai_technology: AMPainterV2 generative adversarial imitation learning with Mixture-of-Experts policy network
